d:
Some songs capture the magic of love in the sweetest way! Enjoy “Aur Tum Aaye” from Dosti: Friends Forever, featuring Bobby Deol and Lara Dutta. Beautifully brought to life by the soulful voices of Alka Yagnik and Sonu Nigam, this melodious track is perfect for fans of romantic Bollywood songs, heartfelt lyrics, and unforgettable Hindi film music.
